**Ordering.** PUNISHER is above NORMAL, and NGH above PUNISHER, at every castle.

**Ramp, castle 1 to castle 10.** NORMAL +43%, PUNISHER +35%, NGH +17%.

**Local dips** (a castle's mean below the previous castle's):
- NORMAL at castle 3;
- PUNISHER at castles 3 and 6;
- NGH at castle 2.

**Separation erosion (owner standard: at most 25% loss of the adjacent-mode percentage advantage from castle 1 to castle 10).**

| pair | castle 1 | castle 10 | erosion | standard |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PUNISHER over NORMAL | +21.8% | +15.3% | **29.7%** | FAIL (limit 25%) |
| NGH over PUNISHER | +27.5% | +10.6% | **61.4%** | FAIL (limit 25%) |
| (NGH over NORMAL, for reference) | +55.3% | +27.6% | 50.2% | n/a |

**Why it erodes (from the curves).** NGH starts near its ceiling: castle 1 is already 943, and it gains only 17% over the climb. NORMAL and
PUNISHER keep rising, by 43% and 35%. The gaps close from below. The castle-1 head starts of the harder modes are large relative to their later
growth.

## 4. Recommendation

- **Engineering readiness: GO.**
  - Every course of every mode generates, is solvable by a hit-free witness, is geometrically clean and reaches castle 10.
  - The full regression suite is green.
  - Saves, recovery and determinism are covered and passing.
- **Release against the owner's difficulty-separation standard: NO-GO.** Both adjacent pairs exceed the 25% erosion limit: 29.7% and 61.4%.
  The measurements are evaluation criteria only. No retuning was done, and none is authorised.
- **The decision for the owner:**
  - **(a)** Authorise a progression-curve correction. This would lift NGH's and PUNISHER's late-castle demand relative to their head start, or
    lower the castle-1 head starts, so that the advantage holds to castle 10. It changes generation, so it needs rules 17, a fingerprint
    refresh, a replay re-record, one CI run and a new campaign on fresh seeds.
  - **(b)** Accept the measured separation for Build 82 and schedule the curve correction for the next build.

Build 82 stays on HOLD: nothing merged, packaged or published; PR #12 is a draft.

## 5. Owner decision (2026-10-28)

- **The owner accepts the measured difficulty separation for Build 82** (option b). The separation item is closed.
- **Why no quick NGH castle 9-10 boost (reviewed with the owner).** NGH already undershoots its castle-10 target: it measures 1,108 against
  1,210. The fairness and proof constraints cap it there, so raising the target alone would most likely not change the courses. A real increase
  would mean more or harder encounters at the top of the hardest mode. That is a generation change needing a rules bump, a CI run and an NGH
  campaign. It is scheduled for the next build, together with the separation erosion.
- **Status.** Engineering GO; separation accepted. The playtest build is ON HOLD at the owner's request while another report is in progress.
  Nothing is merged, packaged or published.
